Presence | > 🏹 **Necro Beam ([Signature Ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability))** > > | **Psionic, Ranged, Strike** | **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |-----------------------------|------------------------------:| > | **📏 Ranged 10** | **🎯 One creature or object** | > > **Power Roll + 4:** > > - **≤11:** 11 corruption damage > - **12-16:** 17 corruption damage; M < 3 [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends) > - **17+:** 20 corruption damage; M < 4 [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends) > > **Effect:** If this damage or the [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) loss from [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) this way reduces a target creature's [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) to 0, that creature dies. > ⭐️ **Psionic Barrier** > > The necrotic eye has damage immunity 15. Использовав основное действие, он теряет этот иммунитет до конца раунда.
